scripts.dev: mkdir -p logs && set -a && source .env && set +a && vite dev --port $PORT 2>&1 | tee logs/server.log
scripts.dev:force: mkdir -p logs && set -a && source .env && set +a && vite dev --port $PORT --force 2>&1 | tee logs/server.log
scripts.clean: pnpm clean:node && pnpm clean:wrangler && pnpm clean:etc
scripts.d1:migrations: wrangler d1 execute baton-d1-local --local --command "select * from d1_migrations order by id"
scripts.d1:migrate:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list baton-d1-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.d1:migrations:staging: wrangler d1 execute baton-d1-staging --env staging --remote --command "select * from d1_migrations order by id"
scripts.d1:migrate:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply baton-d1-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.d1:migrate:list:PRODUCTION: wrangler d1 migrations list baton-d1-production --env production --remote
scripts.d1:migrations:PRODUCTION: wrangler d1 execute baton-d1-production --env production --remote --command "select * from d1_migrations order by id"
scripts.d1:migrate:apply:PRODUCTION: wrangler d1 migrations apply baton-d1-production --env production --remote
